title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། ཚད་མ། ཏེ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 178)
shelf_note: Authentic woodblock print from the Derge Tengyur Pramāṇa (ཚད་མ) section, volume 178 (ཏེ), treating epistemological arguments on causality and rebirth.

pages.prefer_reason: Translation B formats the summary verses (saṃgraha-ślokas) as verse stanzas rather than prose paragraphs and explicitly indicates the continuation from the preceding folio.

book_verdict: Flawless woodblock page scan from the Derge Tengyur with exact OCR transcription and two highly accurate, faithful English translations.
